name: Longball Nights
subtitle: Bat, ball, floodlit ballpark
shortDescription: A batting game with no people on screen: eight spinning pitch types, real ball flight and six ballparks at night.
longDescription:
Baseball's home-run derby is the simplest thrill in the game: one batter, one pitch and a ball sent over the wall. Longball Nights is that moment in real-time 3D for your phone, with a pitching machine on the mound, a bat in your hands, six ballparks under the lights and a ball that flies the way real balls fly.

There are no people in this game by design. The machine throws, you swing, and the stands are a glittering field of phone lights and floodlights. Everything on screen is something you hit or hit with.

Touch the lower screen and drag; the aim ring on the plate follows in small, precise steps so your thumb never hides the ball. Lift to swing. A shrinking timing ring shows the moment. Choose a Power swing for distance and a small sweet spot, or a Contact swing for a bigger one, or use Timing Only and let the game place the ring.

Eight pitch types, fastball, sinker, cutter, slider, curveball, changeup, splitter and a slow practice lob, each with its own spin. Spin bends the path through the air, so the ball does not arrive where it seems headed. A light on the machine tells you what is coming, and the seams tell you more.

Gravity, drag, spin lift and wind decide every flight, and a tailwind carries a drive further. Free with ads; go ad-free with a monthly pass or earn ad-free time by watching videos.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
